interaction: Press and drag inside the cup (or hold Space and steer with the arrow keys) to pour steamed milk onto crema — wiggles fold into rosetta leaves, a quick pull-through makes a heart, and a text line scores the pour ('Nice pour — 72% milk…'); 'Show me a heart' auto-pours one and 'Reset cup' starts again.
notes: Milk is simulated with area-preserving marbling maths (layers pushed outward by new milk, dragged by the stream) rather than a full fluid solver. Open/closed status is computed in Melbourne time.
